why_agent_cannot: an email confirmation link must be opened by the human
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the June AI chat Go to the June AI chat app . It opens in Guest Mode, and a prompt there asks you to sign up to earn points.
2 Step 2 : Sign up with an email Create an account on the Free plan, which the plans page describes as a free email sign-up.
3 Step 3 : Ask questions in the chat Put your questions to June in the chat. The homepage says the more you ask, the more points you earn.
4 Step 4 : Follow the leaderboard June AI runs a global leaderboard for points. Check the June AI homepage for updates on what the points can be redeemed for.
